gaps.title: Token transmitted as URL parameter
gaps.jtbd: When handling authentication tokens, I want to transmit them securely, so that credentials are not leaked.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given a token, When fetching user profile, Then it is passed in the Authorization header
gaps.reason: DOMAIN-STANDARD: OAuth2/OIDC access codes or tokens should not be transmitted as URL query parameters (?code=...) to userinfo endpoints as this leaks credentials. They must be transmitted securely using the Authorization: Bearer header.
